waiting_contract.description: Required when waiting=true. Planner-authored durable identity and recheck policy for the external blocker. Use null when waiting=false. Keep blocker_fingerprint and recheck_token byte-identical while the observed condition is unchanged; change recheck_token only after concrete current evidence changes.

blocker_fingerprint.description: Stable Planner-authored identifier for this blocker, independent of prose wording.

recheck_condition.description: Concrete external observation that would justify rechecking.

recheck_token.description: Stable token for the currently observed blocker state. Reuse it until concrete evidence changes.

stage_reconciliation_required.description: Set true only when current_stage itself prevents the prerequisite work that must happen next. This asks the Manager, the sole stage authority, to decide HOLD versus ROLLBACK; it does not authorize Planner to edit stage state.

allow_verification_probe.description: Whether one verification probe is justified for this exact fingerprint/token pair.

recheck_after_seconds.description: Minimum time after first observing this fingerprint/token before its one allowed probe.

key.description: OPTIONAL local reference name for this task, unique within this new_tasks batch (e.g. 'run-s0', 'analysis'). Other tasks in the same batch reference it via their deps. Use null for flat (non-DAG) tasks.

deps.description: OPTIONAL local keys (from sibling tasks' key fields, same batch only) that must complete before this task runs. Use null or [] for parallel or independent tasks.

meta_decision.description: OPTIONAL — only on a meta-control jump/explore turn. Your OWN call about the search regime (the harness convened the turn on a counter but does not decide for you). The harness records it and re-surfaces your declared forbidden directions next cycle as visibility; it does NOT hard-gate or reject your next candidate. Emit null if you have nothing to declare.

checklist_ops.description: OPTIONAL — you OWN the per-stage checklist. It is seeded from the framework reference; emit ops to tailor it to THIS task (add a missing item, modify an over/under-strict one, remove an irrelevant one, or seed a stage from the reference before editing). Stage-keyed only. The Reviewer cannot edit the checklist — it reports `checklist_feedback`; consume that and act here. Use null or [] when the current checklist is already right.

stage.description: the stage this item belongs to (e.g. 'research', 'simulate')

id.description: stable item id, e.g. 'simulate.seeds'; may be empty only for op=seed

statement.description: the checklist item text (required for add); null when not setting it

evidence_hint.description: where the reviewer looks for evidence; null when not setting it
